text: answer[mkt-1789008830485-f746fd]: Tupac Amaru Shakur, the rapper, actor, and poet, is not alive. He was fatally shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, Nevada, following a concert at The Mansion nightclub, and died from his wounds on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25. His death was the result of a widely reported shooting incident, and his case remains an unsolved crime. While conspiracy theories circulate online suggesting he faked his death, there is no credible evidence supporting that claim. He died, was buried, and has not been seen since.
